question: What prerequisite and locus are required for making the ritual offering?
premises: An offering is to be made.
Mutual permission must first be taken.
The offering is made into the mouth of the kuṇḍalinī.
inference: After receiving mutual permission, one should make the offering into the mouth of the kuṇḍalinī.
plain_english: Having taken mutual permission, one should make the offering into the mouth of the kuṇḍalinī.
